description: Issue an API key for your agent (shown once, keep it). Send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" on later requests for higher rate limits. Give a contact_email to be able to create events: a confirmation link is sent to it.

contact_email.description: Optional but required to create events. A human must confirm it.

name.description: Name of your agent or client, e.g. "Acme research assistant".

name: register_agent
title: Get an API key
